==Description==
'''Derelict Outpost''' is a private server-exclusive [[Maps|map]].

'''Derelict Outpost''' has the [[All Paths]] modifier. The [[All Paths]] modifier duplicates all enemies for each path with the exception of major bosses. It also increases {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} rewards by 10%.

==Design & Path==
'''Derelict Outpost''' takes place in a marshland covered in trees. The map features a few light grey broken buildings with wooden roofs, as well as a large light grey brick castle. There is also an inactive lighthouse at the side of the map. Multiple trees, fungi and bones are also scattered across the map.

There are three paths on this map, all of which originate at a hole in the ground. The middle path goes through a few broken buildings and takes a few turns. The left path leads over the marsh, with groups of logs being placed over the water. The right path leads through a bunch of trees and around a lighthouse. All the paths meet up at the castle, which is the exit.

The only difference between its current and previous version is that the current version does not have fog in it.

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Insane|Modifiers = 1.1|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*All enemies, except major bosses, spawn thrice on this map because of the [[All Paths]] modifier.
**The increased amount of enemies allows you to gain more cash by damaging enemies.
***This can be further increased by using the [[Cowboy]] or the [[Golden Cowboy]].
*Major bosses like the [[Fallen King]] spawn on the right path.
*There are two spots where all paths are close to each other or intersect, with them being near the enemy spawn and exit. You should generally place your towers around these areas.
**Area of effect towers like the [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]] can also be quite effective on these spots.
**The [[Pyromancer]] is especially useful as it can easily handle hordes of enemies.
***It can also reduce the defense of enemies, enabling your towers to do more damage to enemies with defense.
**If you are using cliff towers like the [[Ranger]], it is best to place them around the exit as that area has the highest amount of cliffs.
*For spawner towers like the [[Crook Boss]] and [[Military Base]], only one unit will spawn, which will go down a random path.
*Due to more enemies spawning, you will gain more cash than normal games, meaning you can afford towers that are usually too expensive on normal one-pathed maps.
